OPERATION_TIMEOUT.description: Timeout for SRM operations in seconds (overrides CORE:NAMESPACE_TIMEOUT)

CONN_TIMEOUT.description: Timeout for the HTTP connexion in seconds

COPY_CHECKSUM_TYPE.description: Default checksum type for transfer check

TURL_PROTOCOLS.description: Ordered list of TURL protocols for remote I/O (semicolon-separated, top priority first)

TURL_3RD_PARTY_PROTOCOLS.description: Ordered list of TURL protocols for third party transfer (semicolon-separated, top priority first)

KEEP_ALIVE.description: Enable or disable SRM session re-use

COPY_FAIL_NEARLINE.description: Enable or disable check for source file locality in SRM copy (fail if NEARLINE)

XATTR_FAIL_NEARLINE.description: Enable or disable locality check for REPLICAS XATTR (fail if not ONLINE)
